class.name: ScenarioEventServer
class.brief_description: RID based registry and queue of the scenario's events, its memory and its launchers.
class.description: The original's event_manager, [code]simulation::Memory[/code] and [code]TEventLauncher[/code] ([code]Event.h:638[/code], [code]MemCell.h[/code], [code]EvLaunch.h[/code]). An event is a delay, an optional condition ([ScenarioEventCondition]) and an action ([ScenarioEventAction]); the server knows no event types - what [code]updatevalues[/code] or [code]lights[/code] means is the business of an action. A queued event runs once its time comes: its condition is tested, then the action's [method ScenarioEventAction._run] or [method ScenarioEventAction._run_else] is called. The time is [SimulationServer]'s simulation time, in seconds, which the physics and the drivers read too.

method.name: animation_set_done_event
method.description: Queues [param event] when [param submodel] of the [E3DRenderingServer] [param instance] finishes an animation ([code]TAnimContainer::EventAssign()[/code], [code]Event.cpp:1588-1592[/code]).

method.name: event_attach_action
method.description: Sets what [param event] does when it runs.

method.name: event_attach_condition
method.description: Sets what decides whether [param event] runs its action's [method ScenarioEventAction._run] or [method ScenarioEventAction._run_else]; a null condition always passes.

method.name: event_create
method.description: Creates an event: no delay, no condition, no action.

method.name: event_free
method.description: Frees [param event]; a queued one is taken off the queue ([signal event_dequeued]).

method.name: event_get_action
method.description: What [param event] does when it runs.

method.name: event_get_condition
method.description: What decides how [param event] runs; null for none.

method.name: event_get_delay
method.description: Seconds [param event] waits from being queued to running.

method.name: event_get_departure_delay
method.description: Seconds from the departure of the queueing vehicle's train [param event] runs at, NAN for none (see [method event_set_departure_delay]).

method.name: event_get_name
method.description: The scenery name of [param event].

method.name: event_get_random_delay
method.description: Up to this many seconds more [param event] waits, drawn each time it is queued.

method.name: event_get_rid_by_name
method.description: The event of [param name]; an empty RID for none.

method.name: event_get_run_time
method.description: The simulation time ([method SimulationServer.simulation_get_time]) a queued [param event] runs at, negative when it is not queued.

method.name: event_is_passive
method.description: Whether [param event] is never queued (see [method event_set_passive]).

method.name: event_is_queued
method.description: Whether [param event] waits in the queue.

method.name: event_queue
method.description: Queues [param event] to run after its delay plus [param extra_delay]; [param activator] is the vehicle that queued it. An event is queued once: while it waits, another request is refused and its activator is dropped ([code]event_manager::AddToQuery[/code], [code]Event.cpp:2380-2462[/code]). A passive event is refused. Returns whether it was queued.

method.name: event_set_delay
method.description: Seconds [param event] waits from being queued to running.

method.name: event_set_departure_delay
method.description: Queued by a vehicle, the event runs [param seconds] from the departure of the vehicle's train by its timetable ([method DriverServer.vehicle_get_seconds_until_departure]), not before now, instead of from now ([code]departuredelay[/code], [code]Event.cpp:2431-2444[/code]); [code]NAN[/code] for an event that does not wait for a departure.

method.name: event_set_name
method.description: The scenery name [param event] is found by ([method event_get_rid_by_name]).

method.name: event_set_passive
method.description: A passive event is never queued - nothing runs it; drivers read it on the tracks ahead (the original's [code]m_passive[/code], [code]Event.cpp:2380-2384[/code]).

method.name: event_set_random_delay
method.description: Up to [param seconds] more [param event] waits, drawn each time it is queued.

method.name: isolated_add_event
method.description: Queues [param event] when the [TrackServer] isolated section [param isolated] does what [param slot] says.

method.name: isolated_clear_events
method.description: Takes every event off [param isolated].

method.name: launcher_attach_condition

method.name: launcher_fire

method.name: launcher_fire_shift
method.description: Queues the Shift event of [param launcher] if its condition passes.

method.name: launcher_free
method.description: Frees [param launcher].

method.name: launcher_get_event
method.description: The event [param launcher] fires ([code]Event1[/code], [code]EvLaunch.h[/code]).

method.name: launcher_get_key
method.description: The key that fires [param launcher].

method.name: launcher_get_name
method.description: The scenery name of [param launcher].

method.name: launcher_get_position
method.description: Where [param launcher] stands.

method.name: launcher_get_radius
method.description: How close its user has to be to [param launcher], negative for anywhere.

method.name: launcher_get_rid_by_name
method.description: The launcher of [param name]; an empty RID for none.

method.name: launcher_get_rids
method.description: Every launcher.

method.name: launcher_get_shift_event
method.description: The event [param launcher] fires with Shift ([code]Event2[/code], [code]EvLaunch.h[/code]).

method.name: launcher_set_events
method.description: The event [param launcher] fires, and the one it fires with Shift ([code]Event1[/code], [code]Event2[/code], [code]EvLaunch.h[/code]).

method.name: launcher_set_interval
method.description: [param launcher] fires every [param seconds] of simulated time, 0 for never.

method.name: launcher_set_key
method.description: The key that fires [param launcher].

method.name: launcher_set_name
method.description: The scenery name [param launcher] is found by ([method launcher_get_rid_by_name]).

method.name: launcher_set_position
method.description: Where [param launcher] stands.

method.name: launcher_set_radio_call
method.description: [param launcher] fires when a vehicle's radio sends [param call] within its radius ([code]event_manager::queue_receivers()[/code], [code]Event.cpp:2255-2268[/code]).

method.name: launcher_set_radius
method.description: How close its user has to be to [param launcher], negative for anywhere; a launcher of a radius fires only in reach of the camera ([code]scene.cpp:126-139[/code]).

method.name: launcher_set_time_of_day
method.description: [param launcher] fires when the clock shows [param hour]:[param minute], every day; [param hour] -1 for never ([code]EvLaunch.cpp:197-211[/code]).

method.name: memory_add_friction_track
method.description: [param memory] modifies the friction of [param track] by its values from now on: friction * value1 + value2 (a track's [code]friction <memcell>[/code], [code]Track.cpp:924, 2527-2533, 3526[/code]).

method.name: memory_create
method.description: Creates a memory cell: an empty text and both values 0.

method.name: memory_free
method.description: Frees [param memory].

method.name: memory_get_name
method.description: The scenery name of [param memory].

method.name: memory_get_position
method.description: Where [param memory] stands.

method.name: memory_get_rid_by_name
method.description: The memory of [param name]; an empty RID for none.

method.name: memory_get_text
method.description: The text [param memory] holds.

method.name: memory_get_track
method.description: The track [param memory] stands at; an empty RID for none.

method.name: memory_get_value1
method.description: The first value [param memory] holds.

method.name: memory_get_value2
method.description: The second value [param memory] holds.

method.name: memory_set_name
method.description: The scenery name [param memory] is found by ([method memory_get_rid_by_name]).

method.name: memory_set_position
method.description: Where [param memory] stands - sent with its command to the drivers it reaches.

method.name: memory_set_track
method.description: The track [param memory] stands at ([code]TMemCell::Track[/code], [code]MemCell.h:76[/code]).

method.name: memory_set_values
method.description: Sets the text and both values of [param memory]; the tracks whose friction it modifies follow, and [signal memory_values_changed] is emitted.

method.name: queue_get_events
method.description: Returns the queued events in the order they run.

method.name: track_add_event
method.description: Queues [param event] when a vehicle does what [param slot] says on the [TrackServer] [param track].

method.name: track_clear_events
method.description: Takes every event off [param track].

method.name: track_get_events
method.description: The events of [param track] in [param slot].

signal.name: event_dequeued
signal.description: A queued event left the queue without launching - it was freed (its scenery unloaded). The RID is no longer valid.

signal.name: event_launched
signal.description: [param event], queued by [param activator], came to run - before its condition is tested.

signal.name: memory_values_changed
signal.description: The text or the values of [param memory] were set.
